author: Trotsky, Leon
title: The History of the Russian Revolution
edition: translated by Max Eastman; three volumes, 1932–33
notes: A participant's history, written in exile by the man who chaired the Petrograd Soviet and ran the Military Revolutionary Committee, and filed here as a memoir for that reason: it is evidence of what one of the principals argued, never of what happened. Its account of who led February and of the party's role in October is one of the positions on this pack's historiography cards. Full text at the Marxists Internet Archive, which is why it can be quoted directly; the online edition prints chapter titles rather than the Gollancz pagination, so citations name the chapter.
